TI.P: Decision No 1/2019 of the EU-Korea Committee on Trade and Sustainable Development
on a revised list of experts willing and able to serve as panellists in accordance with Article 13.15 of the Agreement [2019/1734]

PREAMBLE.PREAMBLE.INIT: THE EU-KOREA COMMITTEE ON TRADE AND SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT,

GR.VISA.VISA: Having regard to the Free Trade Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Korea, of the other part, (the Agreement) and in particular Article 13.15(3) thereof,

NP.TXT: Pursuant to Article 13.15(3) of the Agreement, the Parties are to establish a list of at least 15 persons willing and able to serve as panellists with regard to matters arising under Chapter 13 on Trade and Sustainable Development and who have expertise in the issues covered by that Chapter. Of those individuals, at least five are to be non-nationals of either Party and are to serve as chair of the Panel of Experts.

On 27 June 2012, the EU-Korea Committee on Trade and Sustainable Development adopted Decision No 2/2012
Decision No 2/2012 of the EU-Korea Committee on Trade and Sustainable Development of 27 June 2012 on the establishment of a Panel of Experts referred to in Article 13.15 of the Free Trade Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Korea, of the other part (OJ L 331, 1.12.2012, p. 54). establishing a list of 18 experts that may serve as panellists.

The Republic of Korea expressed its wish to replace some of the Korean nationals on the list of experts. In order for this amendment to take effect, the revised list of experts should be approved by the EU-Korea Committee on Trade and Sustainable Development.
Therefore, the Parties have revised the list of experts established by Decision No 2/2012 and the revised list of experts, as set out in the Annex, should be adopted,

ARTICLE.ALINEA: The list of experts that may serve as panellists for the purposes of Article 13.15 of the Agreement, which is set out in the Annex to Decision No 2/2012, is replaced by the list of experts set out in the Annex to this Decision.
This Decision takes effect on the date of its adoption.
